structured_output.title: OperatorHub discontinuation does not affect Helm-deployed cert-manager
structured_output.content: This environment deploys cert-manager v1.17.0 via Helm (Flux HelmRelease, ArgoCD, Helmfile), not OperatorHub/OLM. The upstream change discontinues OperatorHub packages, which only impacts operators installing cert-manager through OperatorHub. Your Helm-based deployment method is unaffected by this change and will continue to work normally in v1.18.0.
